Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system

Class LuksService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.system.LuksService
public final class LuksService extends Object
LUKS front-end for the LFS/BLFS storage manager, normative in system-management-contract.md §4.5. It builds the exact cryptsetup / lfs-encrypt-disk argument vectors and parses cryptsetup status; it never re-implements encryption logic and never writes /etc/crypttab directly (mutations go through the owning CLI, §6).

Operation classes drive the UI's confirmation level:

  • status is read-only and runs unprivileged via ProcessRunner;
  • luksOpen/luksClose/luksAddKey are mutating - confirmed, then escalated via PrivilegedRunner (polkit);
  • luksFormat and lfs-encrypt-disk are destructive (they erase all data) - the UI MUST require a typed confirmation in addition to the polkit prompt.
Passphrases are fed through stdin only, never as command-line arguments (§6).

The command-building and status parsing are pure and unit-testable; the run* helpers are thin wrappers over ProcessRunner / PrivilegedRunner.

    • isAvailable

    • isEncryptDiskHelperAvailable

    • buildCommand

      public static List<String> buildCommand(LuksService.Operation op, String device, String name)
      Builds the argument vector for op. Returns an empty list when the required arguments are blank or the helper for LuksService.Operation.ENCRYPT_DISK is null. The vectors are exactly those in §4.5 - no extra flags are invented.
      Parameters:
      op - the operation
      device - the block device (for OPEN/FORMAT/ADD_KEY/ENCRYPT_DISK)
      name - the LUKS/mapper name (for STATUS/OPEN/CLOSE, optional for ENCRYPT_DISK)

    • parseStatus

      public static Map<String,String> parseStatus(String rawOutput)
      Parses cryptsetup status output into a case-insensitive field map. The tool prints tab/space-indented key: value lines (e.g. cipher: aes-xts-plain64); unrecognised lines are ignored. Pure and lenient.

    • runStatus

      public static ProcessRunner.Result runStatus(String name)
      Runs a read-only cryptsetup status <name> unprivileged. Returns a not-started result for a blank name.

    • runMutating

      public static PrivilegedRunner.PrivilegedResult runMutating(LuksService.Operation op, String device, String name, String passphrase)
      Runs a mutating/destructive operation with polkit escalation, feeding passphrase to the command's stdin (never as an argument). The caller MUST have confirmed first (and, for a destructive op, obtained a typed confirmation). Returns an ERROR result for an invalid vector or a read-only operation.
